search_window.basis: Previous independently verified Care Line watch heartbeat to current observation; bounded recall also considers earlier, newly recovered definite service changes, marking them retrospective rather than falsely claiming new announcement within this hour.

findings.title: Roseland Community Hospital prepares to close labor and delivery unit on Saturday
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Saturday night, the labor and delivery unit will close.
findings.service_line: Hospital labor and delivery / inpatient obstetrics
findings.access_consequences: Hospital's labor and delivery unit set to stop providing services on Saturday night, October 31, 2026; pregnant patients with complications presenting at Roseland's emergency room will be transferred to other hospitals. CBS identifies Advocate Trinity Hospital about 4 miles / 20 minutes away as the closest labor-and-delivery service.
findings.affected_population: Pregnant patients and families in Roseland and Chicago's South Side, especially those requiring emergency obstetric or delivery services.
findings.temporal_note: Retrospective recall of previously announced but definite and imminently effective service cessation. October 30 report was published 10:14 p.m. CDT (8:14 p.m. PDT), before this observation window. Actual completion of shutdown remains unverified as of 00:49 PDT October 31.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall only; production Care Line national collector remains authoritative. Candidate is for review only.
